en.title: EU urges Israel to open Gaza crossings as winter bites, hospital strike condemned
en.dek: Multiple states and the European Union pressed Israel to facilitate aid access as winter conditions intensify in the Gaza Strip.
facts: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas called for immediate and unimpeded humanitarian aid access to Gaza on 14 November 2026
Türkiye and 17 other countries condemned an Israeli airstrike on a Gaza hospital on 14 November 2026
Two Palestinians were killed in an Israeli drone strike in northern Gaza on 14 November 2026
The Israel Defense Forces stated the drone strike targeted two terror operatives
Multiple states requested Israel open land crossings into Gaza as winter conditions begin
body: On 14 November 2026, the European Union called on Israel to provide immediate and unimpeded humanitarian aid access to the Gaza Strip, according to Politico Europe and Al Jazeera. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas stated that Israel must enable the work of the United Nations and its agencies.

The same day, Türkiye and 17 other countries condemned an Israeli airstrike on a hospital in Gaza, according to Anadolu Ajansı and Daily Sabah. The countries called for immediate compliance with a ceasefire and the protection of medical facilities within the conflict zone.

Also on 14 November 2026, an Israeli drone strike in northern Gaza killed two Palestinians, according to reports from the Durango Herald and WKMG. The Israel Defense Forces stated the strike targeted two terror operatives, according to The Times of Israel.
Multiple states requested that Israel open land crossings into Gaza as winter conditions begin, according to The New Arab. The appeal focuses on the need for increased aid access for the region.
SRF and Die Zeit reported that heavy rainfall has flooded tens of thousands of tents in the Gaza Strip, prompting the EU's call for unrestricted border crossings.
The Israel Defense Forces maintained that their recent military operations across the territory were directed at specific targets, according to Anadolu Ajansı.
Anadolu Ajansı reported that two Palestinians were killed during fresh Israeli military operations across the territory on 14 November 2026.
Daily Sabah and Anadolu Ajansı confirmed that 18 nations issued a joint statement urging protection of medical facilities and ceasefire compliance.
en.context: The conflict involves ongoing military operations by the Israel Defense Forces within the Gaza Strip. Multiple nations have expressed concern regarding the impact of these operations on medical facilities and civilian areas, particularly as winter conditions worsen.

en.dek: The European Union and other states have requested that Israel open all land border crossings to facilitate humanitarian aid as winter conditions worsen in the Gaza Strip.
body: Multiple states requested that Israel open land crossings into the Gaza Strip to increase aid access, according to The New Arab. This appeal follows reports that winter conditions are beginning to affect the region.

The European Union also requested that Israel open all border crossings to allow humanitarian aid into the territory, according to SRF and Die Zeit. Both outlets reported that heavy rainfall has flooded tens of thousands of tents in the region.

The Israel Defense Forces stated that a drone strike in northern Gaza on 14 November 2026 targeted two terror operatives, according to The Times of Israel. Reports from the Durango Herald and WKMG confirmed the strike resulted in the deaths of two Palestinians.

Anadolu Ajansı reported that these deaths occurred during fresh Israeli military operations across the territory. The Israel Defense Forces maintained that their recent operations were directed at specific targets.

Türkiye and 17 other countries issued a joint condemnation of an Israeli strike on a hospital in Gaza, according to Anadolu Ajansı and Daily Sabah. These 18 nations called for immediate compliance with a ceasefire and urged the protection of medical facilities within the conflict zone.

de.dek: Die Europäische Union und weitere Staaten haben Israel aufgefordert, alle Landgrenzübergänge zu öffnen, um humanitäre Hilfe zu ermöglichen, da sich die winterlichen Bedingungen im Gazastreifen verschlechtern.
body: Mehreren Staaten zufolge, so The New Arab, wurde Israel aufgefordert, die Landübergänge in den Gazastreifen zu öffnen, um den Zugang für Hilfsgüter zu verbessern. Dieser Appell folgt auf Berichte, wonach winterliche Bedingungen die Region zu beeinträchtigen beginnen.

Die Europäische Union forderte Israel laut SRF und Die Zeit ebenfalls dazu auf, alle Grenzübergänge für humanitäre Hilfe in das Gebiet zu öffnen. Beide Medien berichteten, dass starke Regenfälle zehntausende Zelte in der Region überflutet haben.

Die israelischen Streitkräfte erklärten laut The Times of Israel, dass ein Drohnenangriff im nördlichen Gazastreifen am 14. November 2026 zwei Terroristen gegolten habe. Berichte des Durango Herald und von WKMG bestätigten, dass der Angriff zum Tod von zwei Palästinensern führte.

Anadolu Ajansı berichtete, dass diese Todesfälle während neuer israelischer Militäroperationen im gesamten Gebiet auftraten. Die israelischen Streitkräfte hielten daran fest, dass ihre jüngsten Operationen auf spezifische Ziele gerichtet waren.

Die Türkei und 17 weitere Länder gaben laut Anadolu Ajansı und Daily Sabah eine gemeinsame Verurteilung eines israelischen Angriffs auf ein Krankenhaus in Gaza ab. Diese 18 Nationen forderten die sofortige Einhaltung eines Waffenstillstands und drängten auf den Schutz medizinischer Einrichtungen innerhalb der Konfliktzone.
facts: Die Europäische Union forderte Israel auf, alle Grenzübergänge für humanitäre Hilfe zu öffnen.

Berichten zufolge wurden bei dem Drohnenangriff im nördlichen Gazastreifen zwei Palästinenser getötet.
Die Türkei und 17 weitere Nationen verurteilten einen israelischen Angriff auf ein Krankenhaus in Gaza.
